title: 第21章 追寻人类的修炼秘法第22章 黑暗中的妈妈
content_zh:
很快，张楚把老村长和童青山找来，而后，把小葡萄看到秘籍的事情，告诉了老村长。
童青山听完，顿时欣喜无比。
“先生，我们必须把人类的修炼之法弄来，我想看看，人类的修炼之法，和妖族的修炼之法有什么不同！”童青山很急切。
老村长则一言不发，只是默默的抽着老烟袋。
这时候张楚看向了老村长，开口道：“老村长，我知道你担心这一路的安全，但是，富贵险中求，我们枣叶村能不能蜕变，可能就只有这一次机会了。”
童青山也急忙说道：“对啊，万一错过，那秘籍被别人捡了去，咱们可能再也不会有这种机会。”
终于，老村长说道：“我不是不想拿秘籍，而是这一路，太远了。”
“五百里山路，真正走起来，弯弯绕绕，可能要多四五倍。”老村长说道。
紧接着，老村长叹了一口气：“其实，这么多年来，咱们枣叶村，也不是没人远行，但是，从来没有远行的人回来过。”
“妖墟对人类来说，太危险……”
其实张楚知道老村长在担忧什么。
张楚曾经听说，老村长的亲生儿子，就是因为远行而消失，再也没回来过。
不过张楚还是说道：“好好谋划，也不是不能远行。”
童青山也点头：“没错，以我现在的实力，有意避开危险，应该还是很容易，而且，夜晚来临，我们可以去别人的村落借宿。”
老村长又抽了几口烟，终于下定了决心：“好，既然发现了，那就是我们枣叶村的机缘，应该去争取！”
“不过，能不借宿别人的村落，就不要借宿。”老村长叮嘱道。
张楚顿时微微一愣：“嗯？为什么？”
这时候老村长说道：“其实，在妖墟，并非所有的山村都好客，甚至可以说，大多村子，都不善。”
张楚微微皱眉，在张楚的认知中，周围大多村子，还是挺友善的。
即便是那些被污染的村落，对外村人也很好。

这时候老村长却抽了一口烟，对张楚和童青山说道：“既然你们要远行，我就把一些事情，都告诉你们，免得你们被害了，还不自知。”
“你们知道，为什么我们会生活在妖墟吗？”老村长忽然问道。
张楚和童青山同时摇摇头。
其实张楚很想说，难道枣叶村不是世代生活在此么？
但仔细一想，又觉得不对。
在《大荒经》的描述中，整个大荒，地域无尽，物产丰饶，不知道有多少地方，适宜人类繁衍。
而妖墟，却很明显不是什么好地方，单单一个妖墟的夜晚，就让人非常痛苦。
这时老村长说道：“听老一辈人说，妖墟的村落，来源主要有两部分。”
“第一种，在外界得罪了人，活不下去了，便带领全族，躲入了妖墟。我们枣叶村，就是这种情况。”
“我们老一辈得罪了人，历尽千险万苦，定居下来，尽量与人为善。”
“第二种，就是犯了灭族的重罪，为了逃避外面的律法，躲入了妖墟。这一种，都是恶徒。如果有外来人进入他们的村子，那会发生什么，就说不定了。”
张楚一听，顿时心中恍然，原来妖墟的村落，还有这种来历。
此时老村长叹道：“所以，不是所有村落，都像我们附近的村落一样，这么友善。”
“我听说，有些霸道的村落，你踏入他们的猎区，他们直接开弓射杀。”
“你想要借宿他们村落，没准他们表面上和和气气，晚上就动手把人宰了。”
张楚和童青山听到这话，顿时心惊。
此刻，童青山忍不住说道：“如果这样的话，那晚上不能借宿别人的村落，不是很危险？”
张楚则沉吟道：“如果是这样，那这一次，我们就不能带太多的人，我们两个远行便可以了。”
老村长顿时点头：“先生说的对，这一次，不能带太多人，露宿野外，人越少，越是安全。”
content_en:
Soon, Zhang Chu found the old village chief and Tong Qingshan, and then told the old village chief about the secret book that Xiao Tao had seen.
After hearing this, Tong Qingshan was extremely happy.
"Sir, we must get the human cultivation method. I want to see the difference between the human cultivation method and the demon clan's cultivation method!" Tong Qingshan was very anxious.
The old village chief said nothing and just smoked his old pipe silently.
At this time, Zhang Chu looked at the old village chief and said: "Old village chief, I know you are worried about the safety of this journey, but wealth is found in danger. Whether our Zaoye Village can transform may only have this chance."
Tong Qingshan also said hurriedly: "Yes, if we miss it and the secret book is picked up by others, we may never have this opportunity again."
Finally, the old village chief said: "It's not that I don't want to get the secret book, but this journey is too far."
"The five-hundred-mile mountain road may be four to five times longer if you really walk on it, with twists and turns," the old village chief said.
Then, the old village chief sighed: "Actually, over the years, no one in our Zaoye Village has traveled far, but no one who has traveled far has ever come back."
"The demon ruins are too dangerous for humans..."
In fact, Zhang Chu knew what the old village chief was worried about.
Zhang Chu once heard that the old village chief's biological son disappeared because of a long journey and never came back.
However, Zhang Chu still said: "If you plan carefully, it's not impossible to travel far."
Tong Qingshan also nodded: "Yes, with my current strength, it should be easy to deliberately avoid danger. Moreover, when night comes, we can go to other people's villages to stay overnight."
The old village chief took a few more puffs of cigarette, and finally made up his mind: "Okay, now that we have discovered it, it is an opportunity for us in Zaoye Village, and we should fight for it!"
"However, if you can't stay in other people's villages, don't stay in other people's villages." The old village chief warned.
Zhang Chu was stunned for a moment: "Huh? Why?"
At this time, the old village chief said: "Actually, not all mountain villages in Yaoxu are hospitable. It can even be said that most villages are not good."
Zhang Chu frowned slightly. In Zhang Chu's knowledge, most of the surrounding villages were quite friendly.
Even those polluted villages are very kind to outsiders.
At this time, the old village chief took a puff of cigarette and said to Zhang Chu and Tong Qingshan: "Since you are going to travel far, I will tell you some things to prevent you from being harmed without knowing it."
"Do you know why we live in the Demon Ruins?" the old village chief suddenly asked.
Zhang Chu and Tong Qingshan shook their heads at the same time.
In fact, Zhang Chu really wanted to say, hasn’t Zaoye Village been living here for generations?
But when I thought about it carefully, I felt something was wrong.
According to the description in the Great Wilderness Sutra, the entire Great Wilderness has endless territory and abundant products. There are countless places suitable for human reproduction.
As for the Demonic Ruins, it was obviously not a good place. Just one night in the Demonic Ruins was very painful.
At this time, the old village chief said: "I heard from the older generation that there are two main sources of the villages in Yaoxu."
"The first type is those who have offended others in the outside world and cannot survive anymore, so they lead the entire clan and hide in the demon ruins. This is the case in our Zaoye Village."
"We, the older generation, offended others, went through many dangers and hardships, settled down, and tried our best to be kind to others."
"The second type is those who have committed the serious crime of genocide and hid in the demon ruins in order to escape the laws outside. This type is all villains. If outsiders enter their village, there is no telling what will happen."
When Zhang Chu heard this, he suddenly realized that the village in Yaoxu had such an origin.
At this time, the old village chief sighed: "So, not all villages are as friendly as the villages near us."
"I heard that in some overbearing villages, if you step into their hunting area, they will shoot you with their bows."
"You want to borrowIf you stay in their village, they may appear to be nice and friendly, but then they may kill people at night. "
Zhang Chu and Tong Qingshan were shocked when they heard this.
At this moment, Tong Qingshan couldn't help but said: "If this is the case, wouldn't it be dangerous if you can't stay in other people's villages at night? "
Zhang Chuze pondered: "If this is the case, then we can't bring too many people with us this time, just the two of us can travel far. "
The old village chief nodded immediately: "Sir, you are right. This time, we cannot bring too many people with us and sleep in the wild. The fewer people we have, the safer it will be. "
